LanguageData.GR_ForcedImplantation_CommandDescription: Implant this free Goa'uld symbiote into the first compatible adjacent humanoid. The free symbiote is consumed and its persistent identity moves into the recent-implantation state. This is a manual prototype; autonomous attack behavior is not yet implemented.
LanguageData.GR_ForcedImplantation_NoAdjacentTarget: No compatible adjacent humanoid is available for forced implantation.
LanguageData.GR_ForcedImplantation_InternalError: Forced implantation failed because the recent-implantation state is missing its persistent symbiote component.
LanguageData.GR_ForcedImplantation_Success: {0} has been forcibly implanted by Goa'uld symbiote {1}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHostConversion_Success: {0} is now an active Goa'uld host for symbiote {1}.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtraction_CommandDescriptio: Immediately extract the recently implanted Goa'uld symbiote. The parasite reappears as a free pawn with the same persistent identity. This is a manual prototype; medical surgery requirements and failure risks will be added later.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtraction_InternalError: Emergency extraction failed because the symbiote transfer system is incomplete.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtraction_NoSpawnCell: Emergency extraction failed because no nearby cell can receive the free symbiote.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtraction_Success: {0} has undergone emergency extraction. Goa'uld symbiote {1} is free again.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtractionSurgery_InternalEr: Emergency extraction surgery failed because the persistent symbiote transfer system is incomplete.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtractionSurgery_NoSpawnCel: Emergency extraction surgery failed because no nearby cell can receive the extracted symbiote.
LanguageData.GR_EmergencyExtractionSurgery_Success: {0} has undergone emergency surgery. Goa'uld symbiote {1} is free again.
LanguageData.GR_AutonomousHunt_CommandDescription: Toggle autonomous pursuit. When enabled, this free Goa'uld symbiote periodically searches for the nearest reachable compatible humanoid and implants automatically on contact.
LanguageData.GR_AutonomousImplantation_Success: {0} has been autonomously implanted by Goa'uld symbiote {1}.
LanguageData.GR_RitualImplantation_CommandDescription: Choose one compatible reachable humanoid within ritual range. A Goa'uld ritual basin must remain close to both the free symbiote and the target during the timed ceremony. On completion, the same persistent identity moves into recent implantation.
LanguageData.GR_RitualImplantation_NoNearbyTarget: No compatible reachable humanoid is available within ritual range.
LanguageData.GR_RitualImplantation_Success: {0} has undergone the controlled implantation ritual for Goa'uld symbiote {1}.
LanguageData.GR_RitualImplantation_InvalidTarget: This pawn is not a valid ritual implantation target.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_CancelCommandDescripti: Cancel the current Goa'uld implantation ceremony before completion.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_Started: {0}'s Goa'uld implantation ritual has begun. Keep the target available and within range for {1} ticks.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_CancelledManual: The Goa'uld implantation ritual has been cancelled.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_CancelledInvalid: The Goa'uld implantation ritual was interrupted because its target became unavailable, invalid, unreachable or out of range.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_CompletionFailed: The Goa'uld implantation ritual could not be completed.
LanguageData.GR_RitualCeremony_NoBasinNearby: A nearby Goa'uld ritual basin is required for controlled implantation.
LanguageData.GR_TokraVoluntaryImplantation_CommandDes: Choose one nearby player-controlled compatible humanoid who will voluntarily host this Tok'ra symbiote. The symbiote does not hunt, cannot force implantation and keeps the same persistent identity.
LanguageData.GR_TokraVoluntaryImplantation_NoNearbyTa: No nearby player-controlled compatible humanoid is available for voluntary Tok'ra implantation.
LanguageData.GR_TokraVoluntaryImplantation_InvalidTar: This pawn is not a nearby player-controlled compatible host for voluntary Tok'ra implantation.
LanguageData.GR_TokraHostConversion_Success: {0} has entered active Tok'ra symbiosis with symbiote {1}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldHostTakeover_LetterText: {0} no longer answers to the colony. The symbiote {1} has completed its hold on the nervous system and turned the host over to {2}. The person you knew is still inside, but the body now serves the Goa'uld.
